turnaround_reason: Down ~60% from its $147 high to ~$58 on a 2026 CMS coding/reimbursement disruption that knocked TTM revenue negative (-7.6%). The core hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation OSA business is intact and highly profitable (86% gross margin), so the drawdown is a reimbursement-timing shock, not a demand collapse.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 EPS of $0.14 crushed the -$0.25 estimate (4th straight large beat); management RAISED FY26 revenue guide to $835-875M despite the reimbursement drag
Proposed 2027 CMS reimbursement is +12% (hospital outpatient, $35,414) and +15% (ASC, $31,722) over 2026 — a hard, dated catalyst that reverses the exact headwind that beat the stock down
Fortress balance sheet: $321M cash vs only $29M debt, 8.5x current ratio, positive FCF ($95M TTM) — no financing risk during the reset
Insiders net buyers over 6m (+216k shares, 24 purchase transactions); Inspire V mix is lifting gross margin +150bps
New $30M 'Project Horizon' growth plan; screen in 'basing' mode with +23.7% over the last 30 days suggesting the bottom may be forming
bearish_points: TTM revenue is shrinking (-7.6%) and the coding/reimbursement hit is estimated at $120-130M for the full year — the overhang persists until 2027 rates are FINAL, not just proposed
Nyxoah's Genio just won FDA clearance and launched in the US; first credible direct competitor to Inspire's monopoly, now in an active patent fight (litigation cuts both ways)
Forward P/E of ~38 is not cheap; the market is paying up for a recovery that hasn't fully shown in the top line yet
Listed options are effectively illiquid (total OI ~126 calls / 158 puts) — no clean way to express this with defined risk
catalyst: CMS finalizes 2027 outpatient/ASC reimbursement rates (proposed +12-15%), removing the coding overhang; plus Q3 print showing revenue re-acceleration
suggested_trade: Spot only, starter size. Add on confirmation of the 2027 CMS final rule. Options too thin to use.
key_risk: CMS waters down the proposed 2027 rate increase, or Nyxoah takes share faster than expected — either extends the revenue reset by another year.
would_skip_if: Final 2027 CMS rates come in flat/negative, or Q3 shows continued revenue declines with no reimbursement relief in sight.
